control._comment: bin/dashd-control -- mobile-facing config surface (#30). Binds LAN-reachable (unlike server.host above), so every route past /api/health requires the pairing token; qr.svg/rotate are loopback-only regardless of token.

logs._comment: Log-highlighter panel (#28), source editable from the Control Backend. source_type is 'journalctl' or 'file'.

projects._comment: Projects panel (#62) -- per-repo GitHub issue stats from one `gh api graphql` call covering the authenticated user plus every org they belong to. Owners are always discovered, never listed here (a hand-kept list goes stale the moment an org is joined); exclude_owners only trims. refresh_seconds is deliberately hours -- this is a standing reminder of outstanding work, not a live metric -- and the fetch runs on a background thread so a slow `gh` never stalls /api/state. stale_after_days hides repos untouched that long, keeping dormant projects off the card; 0 disables the cutoff.

weather_alerts._comment: Weather panel highlight (#46). temp_high_f/rain_pct compare directly against weather.temp/precip_prob, which are already in units.temperature/units above -- assumes fahrenheit, matching this config's units. condition_patterns are regex over weather.desc, same {regex, label} shape as logs.patterns above; first match wins.

outputs._comment: Per-output layout overrides. Key = monitor model or connector as reported by the host (see `dashd-host --list`). 'layout' picks a top-level layout in web/app.js; omit an output to use 'auto'.
